modules.name: Source verification, licensing and org strategy
Documents, contracts and signature
modules.axisText: documents, contracts and approvals. Q06–Q07 also contribute to this axis

modules.name: Subscriptions, assets, amendments and renewals
modules.axisText: assets and commercial lifecycle. Show detailed module when recurring products, assets or lifecycle processing exist; otherwise record justified N/A

modules.name: Usage, billing, tax and finance dependencies
modules.axisText: orders, billing and downstream processes. Keep routing questions available even if billing replacement is excluded

modules.name: Testing, rollout, change and proposal readiness

questions.label: What is driving the migration?
questions.detail: Multi: sales productivity; pricing agility; new monetization; partner/self-service; technical debt; data quality; acquisition/consolidation; lifecycle automation; current product strategy; other. Rank top three.

questions.label: What outcomes will make this successful?
questions.detail: Repeatable KPI: quote turnaround; quote error rate; approval turnaround; discount leakage; renewal timeliness; seller adoption; other. Capture baseline, unit, measurement source, target, target date, owner. Do not invent baselines.

questions.label: What is the intended implementation boundary?
questions.detail: Multi: configure/price/quote; approvals; documents; contracts; orders; assets/subscriptions; amendments/renewals; integrations; reporting; billing; usage; revenue recognition; portals; orchestration; Agentforce. Apply SCOPE separately to each.

questions.label: Which business units and legal entities are involved?
questions.detail: Repeatable entity/BU with sponsor, region, currency, country and intended rollout wave.

questions.label: Who will use quoting and who will approve the design?
questions.detail: Repeatable persona: direct seller; partner seller; sales ops; pricing; finance; legal; product; support; admin. Count active users, peak concurrency, named SME and design authority.

questions.label: What deadlines or business events constrain delivery?
questions.detail: Date/range + reason: renewal; peak season; launch; contract commitment; fiscal close; other. Hard/target deadline; decision authority; blackout windows.

questions.label: What budget information can the internal team use?
questions.detail: Internal-only, optional: not established; indicative range; approved envelope. Currency and low/high amount; services/license split if available.

questions.label: What level of process change is acceptable?
questions.detail: Single: preserve outcomes with minimal user change; simplify selected processes; redesign end-to-end; undecided. Record non-negotiable business outcomes.

options.label: Preserve outcomes with minimal user change

questions.label: Who owns decisions and customer dependencies?
questions.detail: Repeatable RACI by workstream, escalation route, weekly SME availability and approval turnaround.

questions.label: What is explicitly excluded?
questions.detail: Repeatable exclusion: capability/system/BU; reason; retained owner; interface responsibility; revisit trigger.

questions.label: Which source product is actually installed?
questions.detail: Multi: Salesforce CPQ/SBQQ; Salesforce Billing/blng; Industries CPQ; custom quoting; other. Package version, verification date, evidence. Multiple paths trigger architect review.

questions.label: What is the source landscape?
questions.detail: Repeatable org: production/sandbox; org alias, edition, release, region, BU, system owner. Do not ask for credentials.

questions.label: Which target licenses and features are confirmed?
questions.detail: Repeatable target product/SKU, entitlement status: purchased; quoted; under evaluation; unavailable. Feature permissions, user counts, usage limits if known, supporting order form/reference, validation owner/date.

questions.label: What is the deployment model?
questions.detail: Same production org; existing different org; new org; undecided. Capture wider org-strategy decision and affected clouds.

questions.label: Will legacy CPQ and the new solution run concurrently?
questions.detail: YN + expected duration, split by BU/product/channel, shared Account/Product2/price book governance and transaction routing owner.

questions.label: Where does billing run today and what will change?
questions.detail: Source: Salesforce Billing; ERP; external subscription platform; custom/manual; mixed. Target per system: retain; migrate; dependency only; undecided.

questions.label: What other Salesforce capabilities share the org?
questions.detail: Multi: Sales; Service; Experience; Field Service; industry cloud; other. Shared automation, data and permission dependencies.

questions.label: Are suitable environments available?
questions.detail: Repeatable dev/test/UAT/performance/training/preprod; target feature provisioning, refresh cadence, data masking, owner and readiness date.

questions.label: What licensing and coexistence questions need Salesforce confirmation?
questions.detail: Repeatable question, release/SKU, requested decision, owner, due date, answer/source. Do not fabricate entitlement or overlap-cost assurances.

questions.label: How large is the active and historical product catalog?
questions.detail: COUNT for active, inactive and sold-in-last-12-months products; families and source system; date of measurement.

questions.label: Which products and selling models are used?
questions.detail: Multi: one-time; recurring; perpetual; services; hardware; usage; hybrid; ramped/multi-period. Selling term, UOM, provisioning type per family.

questions.label: What bundle structures are used?
questions.detail: Multi: standalone; static bundle; configurable bundle; nested bundle; dynamic bundle. Bundle count, maximum depth, min/max options and inter-bundle dependency inventory.

questions.label: Which attributes drive product selection?
questions.detail: Repeatable: attribute; datatype; allowed values; variant/SKU implication; commercial/technical purpose; owner; source of truth.

questions.label: What configuration rules must be preserved?
questions.detail: Multi: selection; validation; filtering; alerts; inclusion/exclusion; quantity dependencies; compatibility. Inventory active/inactive counts, evaluation scope/order, rule examples and business purpose.

questions.label: Is guided selling used?
questions.detail: YN; if yes: question tree, selection logic, channels, result ranking, maintenance owner and examples.

questions.label: How are products governed and released?
questions.detail: MODE + lifecycle approval, effective dates, localization, channel availability, catalog versioning and retirement.

questions.label: How should the catalog change?
questions.detail: Multi: retain SKU structure; simplify duplicates; introduce attributes; separate commercial/technical view; standardize families; redesign bundles. Capture affected family and business justification.

questions.label: Does configuration require an external engine?
questions.detail: YN + vendor, rules boundary, APIs, latency, licensing, retain/replace/dependency scope and vendor owner.

questions.label: What difficult configurations must the target prove?
questions.detail: Repeatable scenario with input selection, valid/invalid outcomes, constraint explanation and linked source quote or configuration evidence.

subfields.label: Linked source quote or configuration evidence

questions.label: Which pricing methods are used?
questions.detail: Multi: list; cost-plus; block; slab/tier; volume; term; percent-of-total; contracted/account-specific; attribute-based; formula; usage; custom. Map each to product families.

questions.label: How many price rules exist and which are active?
questions.detail: COUNT active/inactive; conditions/actions; evaluation event/order; dependencies; business owner and examples. Link detailed logic register.

questions.label: How are discounts and promotions applied?
questions.detail: Multi: manual; volume; term; partner/distributor; discretionary; promotion; rebate; customer agreement. Stacking order, exclusivity, caps and approval threshold.

questions.label: Are customer-specific prices or agreements used?
questions.detail: YN + agreement count, account/contract scope, effective dates, precedence, tiering, currency and migration/retention decision.

questions.label: Which pricing precision and currency rules apply?
questions.detail: Multi-currency YN, currency list, conversion owner, FX date policy, decimal precision, tax-inclusive/exclusive, rounding at unit/line/total.

questions.label: Is a Quote Calculator Plugin or other pricing code used?
questions.detail: YN + JavaScript QCP, Apex, formula, external service. Capture repository/file reference, approximate size, hooks, purpose, dependencies, owner and tests. Never paste credentials.

questions.label: Which calculation behaviors are business-critical?
questions.detail: Multi: cross-line totals; bundle allocation; margin floors; partner waterfall; mixed UOM; proration; percent-of-total; custom uplift; external cost; multi-pass recalculation. Repeatable worked examples with input/output.

questions.label: How do pricing changes take effect?
questions.detail: Single: immediate; effective-dated; manual release; mixed. Price protection for open quotes, renewals and contracted customers.

questions.label: Can the team provide a representative quote pack?
questions.detail: YN; scenarios and evidence for standard/edge/negative outcomes, original inputs, output waterfall, expected result, currency and business-approved tolerance.

questions.label: What should pricing achieve in the future?
questions.detail: Multi: parity; simplify rules; common engine across channels; new models; faster calculation; transparent waterfall; delegated maintenance. PRIORITY per selected requirement.

questions.label: Are pricing inputs held outside Salesforce?
questions.detail: Multi: ERP cost; exchange rates; inventory; customer eligibility; entitlement; tax; other. Source freshness, timeout fallback, caching and owner.

questions.label: What is the quoting workload?
questions.detail: Numeric monthly quotes, peak daily quotes, typical/P95/max lines per quote, concurrent sellers, measurement period. Do not derive one from the other.

questions.label: What quote actions and structures are used?
questions.detail: Multi: groups; favorites; clone; multi-scenario; multiple quotes per opportunity; primary quote; alternatives; line mass edit; quote import; split quotes.

questions.label: How customized is the quote editing experience?
questions.detail: Standard with settings; additional fields; custom screens/components; external UI; mixed. Layouts, actions, validations, persona/channel differences.

questions.label: What selling channels use CPQ?
questions.detail: Multi: direct; partner; distributor; ecommerce; self-service; contact center; API/headless. Volumes, user model and scope per channel.

questions.label: How are quote and opportunity data synchronized?
questions.detail: Single: standard behavior; customized automation; manual; mixed. Field rules, timing, error ownership, competing automations.

questions.label: How are approvals implemented?
questions.detail: Multi: standard approvals; Advanced Approvals package; Flow/custom; external; none. Steps, approver logic, parallel/sequential routes, package version if relevant.

questions.label: What approval exceptions must be retained?
questions.detail: Multi: delegated approver; resubmission; smart reapproval; conditional escalation; SLA; recall; mobile approval; other. Include business rule and example.

questions.label: What causes seller friction today?
questions.detail: Rank: slow calculation; product search; data re-entry; errors; approval delays; documents; amendments; other. Capture frequency and evidence; avoid implying all are present.

questions.label: Which quote performance outcomes are required?
questions.detail: Numeric P95 browse/configure/calculate/save target, quote-size class, network condition and pass/fail measurement method.

questions.label: How should sellers transition?
questions.detail: Single: all at once; by persona; by BU; by product family; undecided. Record training needs, champions, accessibility and change constraints.

questions.label: Which documents are generated?
questions.detail: Multi: quote; order form; SOW; agreement; amendment; renewal notice; other. COUNT active templates and archive templates.

questions.label: What template logic is used?
questions.detail: Multi: conditional sections; grouped lines; complex totals; multilingual; multiple brands/legal entities; annexes; rich text; external data. Provide redacted examples.

questions.label: What generates and signs documents?
questions.detail: Repeatable tool: CPQ templates; Salesforce document tooling; Conga; DocuSign; Adobe; custom; other. Retain/replace/dependency and vendor owner.

questions.label: What contract lifecycle behavior is required?
questions.detail: Multi: clause library; redlining; approval; obligation tracking; repository; parent/child contracts; expiry alerts; other. SCOPE per capability.

questions.label: Which document and contract records must remain accessible?
questions.detail: Single: active only; full history; legal retention subset; external archive. Retention, audit access, signer evidence and open envelopes at cutover.

questions.label: How will legal correctness be verified?
questions.detail: Reviewer, entity/language-specific sample, required clauses, output comparison method, acceptance owner.

questions.label: Which post-sale actions occur?
questions.detail: Multi: renew; upsell; downsell; cancel; suspend/resume; swap; transfer; split/merge; early termination; evergreen; none.

questions.label: What is the installed base?
questions.detail: COUNT contracts, active subscriptions, assets, amendment/renewal records and monthly lifecycle transaction volumes. Clarify which objects represent entitlements.

questions.label: How are renewals initiated and priced?
questions.detail: Multi: automated; seller initiated; customer initiated; external. Renewal grouping, uplift, coterm, term changes, price protection, notification and ownership.

questions.label: How complete is the lifecycle history?
questions.detail: Complete; missing selected amendments; opening balances only; inconsistent across products. Capture lineage from original sale through all changes, dated quantities/prices, orphan records and evidence.

subfields.label: Lineage from original sale through all changes

questions.label: How do midterm changes calculate?
questions.detail: Repeatable effective-date scenario: proration basis; quantity changes; uplift; credit/debit; backdating; coterm; multiple amendments; contracted price. Source and expected result required.

questions.label: How are bundles represented after sale?
questions.detail: Single: component-level; parent only; mixed; external. Identify hierarchy, asset identifiers and lifecycle relationships.

questions.label: Which migration treatment is preferred?
questions.detail: Historical orders generating lifecycle records; direct asset creation subject to validation; retain legacy lifecycle processing temporarily; undecided. Architect must validate method and required related records.

options.label: Direct asset creation subject to validation

questions.label: What is the treatment of in-flight lifecycle transactions?
questions.detail: Repeatable cohort: pending amendment; renewal opportunity; unsigned quote; cancellation; future-dated order. Complete in legacy; recreate in target; migrate with validation; hold for decision.

questions.label: Can business owners prove continuity after migration?
questions.detail: Golden scenarios for first renewal, post-migration amendment, cancellation, coterm, backdated event and mixed migrated/new products; include expected quantities, dates and amounts.

questions.label: Which future lifecycle improvements are desired?
questions.detail: Multi: self-service; automation; unified asset view; consistent renewals; new monetization; other. PRIORITY and measurable outcome.

questions.label: What creates an order and what is its scope?
questions.detail: Quote acceptance; contract activation; manual; external API; mixed. Partial orders, split orders, multiple locations/entities and handoff event.

questions.label: How do order states flow downstream?
questions.detail: Repeatable source state, target state, event, fulfillment system, acknowledgement, failure/retry, owner.

questions.label: What fulfillment complexity exists?
questions.detail: Multi: commercial-to-technical decomposition; dependencies; provisioning; shipment; service activation; orchestration; none. SCOPE for any new orchestration.

questions.label: How are order changes handled?
questions.detail: Multi: cancel before activation; change in progress; partial fulfillment; future dating; backdating; returns; external change. Capture accepted behavior and constraints.

questions.label: Who owns asset creation and activation?
questions.detail: Salesforce; ERP; external platform; mixed. Trigger, lifecycle date, duplicate prevention and reconciliation.

questions.label: What open orders will exist at cutover?
questions.detail: COUNT and state distribution, handling approach, system of record, reconciliation owner and signed transition rule.

questions.label: What downstream finance boundary applies?
questions.detail: Repeatable invoicing, tax, collections, payment, revenue recognition, general ledger and reporting system; SCOPE per capability.

questions.label: How are billing timing and amounts determined?
questions.detail: Multi: upfront; arrears; milestone; installment; recurring; usage; hybrid. Frequency, bill-to/sold-to, PO, legal entity, billing account and currency.

questions.label: What usage models are in scope?
questions.detail: Multi: none; metered; tiered; included allowance; minimum commitment; prepaid credit; drawdown; overage; true-up; rollover. Future requirement versus current use separately.

subfields.label: Future requirement versus current use separately

questions.label: How are usage events rated and corrected?
questions.detail: If usage selected: meter/source, event volume, UOM, aggregation period, late/duplicate events, corrections, rating owner, reconciliation and audit examples.

questions.label: What financial adjustments must survive?
questions.detail: Multi: credit notes; debit notes; refunds; write-offs; tax changes; cancellations; invoice reruns; none. Owner and system responsibility.

questions.label: What financial data must be migrated or reconciled?
questions.detail: Active schedules; open balances; invoice history; transaction history; none in migration. Data owner, retention location, continuity method and evidence.

questions.label: What is the target license/release dependency?
questions.detail: Record candidate feature, licensed entitlement evidence, release/availability source and architect validation. Unconfirmed features stay open dependencies.

questions.label: What must finance sign off?
questions.detail: Repeatable totals, account mapping, invoice amount/date, tax, credit, downstream reconciliation and close-period constraints.

questions.label: Which systems exchange CPQ data?
questions.detail: Multi: ERP; product master; pricing; commerce; partner portal; CLM; e-signature; billing; tax; payments; data platform; provisioning; other. Create one register row per actual interface, not merely per vendor.

subfields.label: Create one register row per actual interface

questions.label: What does each interface do?
questions.detail: Repeatable direction, objects, operation/event, current endpoints, payload/schema reference, business process and external owner.

questions.label: How is each interface implemented?
questions.detail: Multi per interface: MuleSoft; other middleware; REST; SOAP; platform events; CDC; batch/file; direct DB; custom Apex; other. Protocol, auth method name and delivery pattern; no secrets.

questions.label: What references legacy objects or semantics?
questions.detail: Per interface: SBQQ field/object, package action/API, calculation timing, custom endpoint or event schema; impact and proposed change.

questions.label: What service levels and recovery behavior are required?
questions.detail: Numeric normal/peak volume, latency, availability, RTO/RPO if relevant; idempotency, retries, DLQ, replay, reconciliation, monitoring and support owner.

questions.label: What can constrain interface changes?
questions.detail: Multi: vendor lead time; ERP release window; API limits; licenses; private network; security review; other. Responsible party and committed date.

questions.label: Will APIs support multiple selling channels?
questions.detail: YN; channel-specific context, identity/authorization, pricing consistency, transaction ownership and performance.

questions.label: Are test endpoints and owners ready?
questions.detail: Environment availability, contract/schema, sample payloads, test account, external team commitment and acceptance evidence.

questions.label: What custom components depend on CPQ?
questions.detail: Multi: Apex; Flow; legacy workflow/Process Builder; validation; formula; LWC/Aura; Visualforce; triggers; external code; none. Counts and inventory per type.

questions.label: How well are dependencies understood?
questions.detail: HEALTH; dependency graph, code references, callouts, field/object usage, trigger ordering and ownership.

questions.label: Which package-specific hooks are used?
questions.detail: Multi: QCP; page security plugin; custom actions; guided-selling plugin; document extensions; external calculation; other. Current purpose and redesign hypothesis.

questions.label: Which third-party packages are involved?
questions.detail: Repeatable vendor/package/version, business function, dependencies, licensing, compatibility confirmation and support owner.

questions.label: How are changes built and released?
questions.detail: Multi: source control; Salesforce CLI; Copado; Gearset; other CI/CD; change sets; manual. Branching, approvals and rollback.

questions.label: Which reusable automated tests exist?
questions.detail: Multi: Apex; UI; API; pricing regression; data reconciliation; none. Coverage scope, reliability, execution time and repository reference.

questions.label: What engineering constraints apply?
questions.detail: Multi: shared release train; code freeze; security gate; limited environments; restricted package install; other. Owner and lead time.

questions.label: How should each custom component be treated?
questions.detail: Repeatable reuse unchanged after proof; reconfigure; redesign; rebuild; replace with native feature after proof; retire; undecided. Business justification and acceptance test.

subfields.label: Replace with native feature after proof

questions.label: Which data must be available after go-live?
questions.detail: Multi: products; price books; accounts/contacts; quotes/lines; contracts; subscriptions; assets; orders/lines; agreements; usage; billing records; attachments; history. Per dataset: migrate; reference/archive; retain legacy; recreate; retire; undecided.

questions.label: What are dataset volumes and growth?
questions.detail: Per object: total/active, period, monthly change, file size, historical depth, source owner; exact versus estimate.

questions.label: What quality issues exist?
questions.detail: Multi: duplicates; missing mandatory fields; orphan relationships; invalid dates; inconsistent currency; broken bundle structure; incomplete history; obsolete products; conflicting prices; none proven. Measured counts/sample size, not impressions only.

questions.label: Who owns cleansing and data acceptance?
questions.detail: Per dataset: SI/customer/shared, named owner, rules, deadline and sign-off authority.

questions.label: How will objects and fields map?
questions.detail: Open object/field mapping grid with source/target object, field, datatype, transform, defaults, lookup keys, validation and disposition. Target API names require validation.

questions.label: What history and audit evidence must be retained?
questions.detail: Single: full; active plus selected history; legally defined subset; archive only. Retention reason, access method, deletion restrictions and ownership.

questions.label: How will migration be executed?
questions.detail: Multi: ETL; APIs; data loader; accelerator; custom pipeline; undecided. Load dependencies, batch size hypothesis, retries, upsert keys, error quarantine and rerun behavior.

questions.label: How will delta changes and freeze be managed?
questions.detail: Full freeze; incremental loads; dual-operation synchronization; phased cohort freeze; undecided. Window, change capture, cutoff timestamp/timezone and owner.

questions.label: What reconciliation will prove success?
questions.detail: Counts; amounts; lineage; date/quantity balances; references; pricing; downstream totals; lifecycle scenarios. Thresholds, excluded records, owner and evidence.

questions.label: What happens to legacy data and the package?
questions.detail: Retain editable temporarily; read-only access; archive then decommission; undecided. Required retrieval, retention, dependencies, licensing validation and approved exit criteria.

questions.label: What reports rely on CPQ records?
questions.detail: COUNT reports, dashboards, extracts and external datasets. Active usage, owner and linked objects/fields.

questions.label: Which business measures must continue?
questions.detail: Multi: pipeline; bookings; ARR/MRR; renewal; churn; discount/margin; quote cycle; approvals; usage; other. Capture agreed formula, grain, date and source.

questions.label: How will legacy and new results be compared?
questions.detail: Single: parallel reports; consolidated warehouse; bridge mapping; new baseline; undecided. Historical comparability and restatement decisions.

questions.label: What analytics platforms consume data?
questions.detail: Multi: native Salesforce; Tableau; CRM Analytics; Power BI; warehouse; spreadsheets; other. Refresh and interface dependencies.

questions.label: How will reporting acceptance be measured?
questions.detail: Sample period, report/metric baseline, tolerance, reconciliation logic and business approver.

questions.label: Which access boundaries apply?
questions.detail: Multi: BU; region; legal entity; partner account; role; product; price/cost; margin; sensitive customer fields. Record visibility and edit rules per persona.

questions.label: Which security capabilities are used or required?
questions.detail: Multi: SSO; MFA; permission sets/groups; field access; encryption; audit logging; monitoring; data masking; other. Distinguish current use, future need, licensed entitlement.

questions.label: What data handling requirements apply?
questions.detail: Multi: PII; commercial confidential; financial; regulated data; cross-border restrictions; other. Customer-approved classification, permitted evidence storage and retention. Do not infer compliance.

questions.label: What resilience and support outcomes are required?
questions.detail: Numeric availability, support hours/timezone, criticality, recovery objective, backup/restore responsibility and incident escalation.

questions.label: What architecture and security approvals are needed?
questions.detail: Repeatable review, assessor, evidence, deadline, decision and unresolved conditions.

questions.label: What operational monitoring must be in place?
questions.detail: Multi: pricing failures; integration errors; failed jobs; quote latency; access anomalies; migration exceptions; asset reconciliation; other. Alert and support owner.

questions.label: What rollout approach is preferred?
questions.detail: Single: one cutover; BU/region waves; product waves; channel waves; new business first with legacy renewals retained; undecided. Reason, risk appetite and decision owner.

options.label: New business first with legacy renewals retained

questions.label: What test scenarios and expected results exist?
questions.detail: Repeatable golden transaction, normal/edge/negative, persona/channel, dataset, expected output, tolerance, owner and evidence.

questions.label: Who owns each test stage?
questions.detail: Repeatable unit; functional; integration; migration rehearsal; pricing parity; performance; security; UAT; regression. RACI, environment and entry/exit criteria.

questions.label: What data migration rehearsals are required?
questions.detail: Integer planned rehearsals, volume class, duration target, reconciliation scope and accountable owner.

questions.label: What are cutover and rollback conditions?
questions.detail: Tasks and dependency order, freeze, final delta, go/no-go criteria, business owner, rollback/forward recovery triggers and transaction reconciliation after go-live.

questions.label: How will users become ready?
questions.detail: Multi: persona training; champions; sandbox practice; job aids; train-the-trainer; office hours; other. Counts, languages, owner, training acceptance.

questions.label: What support follows go-live?
questions.detail: Hypercare duration, coverage hours/timezone, support tiers, incident targets, knowledge transfer and BAU exit criteria.

questions.label: What proposal and delivery constraints should we honor?
questions.detail: Delivery locations, permitted onsite/offshore mix, working hours, customer/vendor responsibilities, procurement timing, rate currency and commercial exclusions. Internal commercial fields remain restricted.

questions.label: What decisions and assumptions remain open?
questions.detail: Repeatable decision/assumption, impact, owner, due date, validation plan, possible scope/cost/schedule effect and customer-visible flag.

questions.label: Who approves the assessment baseline?
questions.detail: Named engagement lead, architect and customer approver; approval state, date, comments, unresolved exceptions. Acknowledgement is not legal acceptance of a contract.
